build_cfm_model: build a CFM model with a transformer backbone for conditional flow matching TTS
sample_audio_cfm: sample audio from a CFM model using text conditioning and neural ODE sampling
train_cfm_model: train a CFM model with flow matching loss and classifier-free guidance
configure_cfm_sampling: configure CFM sampling with steps, CFG strength, and EPSS timestep pruning
get_cfm_device: get the device a CFM model is running on for inference placement
